# MakerLens Assets

> Free, browser-based RPG Maker asset viewer and extractor. Runs 100% client-side — files are never uploaded.

## What it does

MakerLens Assets lets you open encrypted RPG Maker game files directly in your browser and preview or download the images and audio inside.

- **RPG Maker 2000 / 2003**: open the game folder; `.xyz` images are shown and saved as PNG, next to plain `.png`, `.bmp`, `.wav`, `.mid` and `.mp3` files. Nothing is encrypted.
- **RPG Maker XP / VX / VX Ace**: open the game folder, or a `.rgssad`, `.rgss2a`, or `.rgss3a` archive directly. No key needed — it's embedded in the archive.
- **RPG Maker MV / MZ**: open the game folder; the encryption key is auto-read from `data/System.json`. Supports `.rpgmvp`, `.png_` (images) and `.rpgmvo`, `.rpgmvm`, `.ogg_`, `.m4a_` (audio).
- Also: filter by image size or audio length, hide files with identical content ("Unique only"), download a folder as a ZIP.

## Who it's for

Modders and translators working with the rights holder's permission, developers and artists recovering their own work, and anyone who wants to look at a game's images and music without installing software. Not a batch/CLI converter. Part of the MakerLens family (https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/); MakerLens Events (https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/events/) shows the same game's event flow.

## Key features

- Zero install — runs in any modern browser at https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/
- Auto key detection from `System.json`
- Audio preview with duration display
- Lightbox image viewer with keyboard navigation
- Download individual files or export whole folders as ZIP
- Search files by name; filter by type, image size and audio length
- Drag-and-drop support
- Light/dark theme (follows your system setting by default)

## Use it

https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/ — select the game folder (any version) or the archive (XP/VX/VX Ace), or paste a game link made by rpgmaker-web-toolkit. Chrome and Edge open folders directly; other browsers pick the folder through the file dialog.

## FAQ

How to open .rpgmvp / .png_ / .rgss3a files, where the key comes from, ZIP export, supported versions and legal notes: https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/faq.html

## Privacy

All processing happens inside your browser. No files or keys are ever uploaded or sent to any server. The public site counts anonymous page visits (page path and referrer) and a few actions by fixed name (how a game was opened, which feature was used; never what was opened), with GoatCounter and no cookies. Details: https://makerlens.kokoroou.workers.dev/assets/privacy.html

## Supported formats

`.rpgmvp`, `.png_`, `.rpgmvo`, `.rpgmvm`, `.ogg_`, `.m4a_`, `.rgssad`, `.rgss2a`, `.rgss3a`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.bmp`, `.ogg`, `.m4a`, `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.mid` (download only), `.xyz` (RPG Maker 2000 / 2003, shown and saved as PNG)
